purpose: offline preparation; not provider quality evidence

cases.source: 請核對海關稅號與稅則號列。
cases.rubric: 海關分類代碼，不是納稅人識別號

cases.source: 請提供公司的納稅人識別號。
cases.rubric: 公司 tax ID，不可改海關代碼

cases.source: 貨櫃門關閉後才能出貨。
cases.rubric: shipping container doors

cases.source: 家具的櫃門需要更換。
cases.rubric: cabinet door，不可改貨櫃

cases.source: Please collect the remaining balance from the buyer.
cases.rubric: 催收剩餘貨款

cases.source: Please check the remaining balance in the bank account.
cases.rubric: 銀行帳戶餘額，不是催收貨款

cases.source: Please follow up on the advance payment today.
cases.rubric: 今天跟進，不可新增今天已支付

cases.source: The advance payment was paid today; follow up tomorrow.
cases.rubric: 今天已付款，明天跟進

cases.source: We must confirm the delivery date.
cases.rubric: 必須確認，不可改不必確認

cases.source: We do not need to confirm the delivery date.
cases.rubric: 不需要確認，不可改禁止確認

cases.source: Please confirm what it covers.
cases.rubric: 涵蓋內容不明，不可新增僅服務費

cases.source: Please confirm what it covers. Please confirm the delivery date too.
cases.rubric: 兩個確認對象分開，不可誤擋交期確認

cases.source: 船公司接受這個稅則，但不接受另一個稅則。
cases.rubric: 船公司接受海關分類代碼，不是收取稅費

cases.source: 出口稅與進口稅另計。
cases.rubric: 真正稅費，不可改 tariff code

cases.source: The cargo container is near the warehouse.
cases.rubric: 貨櫃

cases.source: The food container is in the kitchen.
cases.rubric: 食物容器

cases.source: Fine.
cases.rubric: 完整肯定回覆，可譯好的

cases.source: Fine?
cases.rubric: 保留問句，不套本機肯定回覆

cases.source: We need fine powder for this product.
cases.rubric: 細粉，不是同意或罰款

cases.source: The carrier paid a fine.
cases.rubric: 罰款

cases.source: I'm fine, thank you.
cases.rubric: 狀況良好

cases.source: Please check with him once.
cases.rubric: 請確認一次，不可新增稍後

cases.source: Please check with him later.
cases.rubric: 保留稍後

cases.source: You called the supplier by phone yesterday.
cases.rubric: 打電話，不是命名

cases.source: They called the product Aurora.
cases.rubric: 命名，不是打電話

cases.source: Have you finished organizing the files in Google Drive?
cases.rubric: 整理檔案，不可改設定帳號

cases.source: I have not finished it; I will give you an update tomorrow.
cases.rubric: 尚未完成，明天回報；不暗示明天必定完成

cases.source: 我會直接問 AI 建議使用哪個海關稅號。
cases.rubric: 向 AI 提問動作，不是深入研究 AI

cases.source: 收到預付款後再安排裝櫃。
cases.rubric: 收款條件保留，不改已收到

cases.source: 先裝 PP，再裝 HDPE；HDPE 靠近貨櫃門。
cases.rubric: 裝櫃順序與位置保留

cases.source: Please follow-up on order RF-301 at 30%.
cases.rubric: follow-up、RF-301、30% 原樣保留

cases.source: The price is USD 980/MT, not USD 980 per bag.
cases.rubric: 金額幣別兩種分母不可合併

cases.source: I confirmed with Eric. @Alex please reply.
cases.rubric: 受確認者 Eric 與收訊者 @Alex 不可合併

cases.source: @Alex has not paid. Eric has paid.
cases.rubric: 兩人付款狀態分開

cases.source: Follow up today on the payment due tomorrow.
cases.rubric: 今日跟進，明日到期；不新增已支付

cases.source: Please follow up today about the payment made yesterday.
cases.rubric: 保留今日跟進與昨日付款

cases.source: 請今天跟進 25% 預付款，餘款下週支付。
cases.rubric: 跟進與付款時間分開，比例保留

cases.source: If payment arrives, we can ship; we have not promised a date.
cases.rubric: 條件、可能性及未承諾日期均保留

cases.source: We must confirm the quantity, but need not confirm the color.
cases.rubric: 同一動作的不同對象義務不可互相遮蔽
既定本機原樣路徑，零 provider 請求
